title: Case 047: Company Payment Limit
initial_request: Maeve wants to know the current outgoing-payment limit on her company profile before arranging a substantial supplier payment.
overview: Maeve saw a planned supplier payout in the business portal and asked H&V to confirm the applicable company limit. The agent checked her authority to view limits and the active setting before sharing it securely.

next_action.summary: Check Maeve’s viewing mandate and the active company payment-limit setting in H&V’s limit register before responding.

outcome: H&V confirmed that the current limit is £20,000 per outgoing payment. No limit increase was made, and the payout was not submitted or executed.

events.body: I can see a planned supplier payout in the portal, but I have not submitted it. I need to know the current outgoing-payment limit for our company profile before I arrange it.
Please confirm our current company payment limit. I’m authorised to view limits, and I need the setting for a substantial supplier payment.
I’m checking Maeve Calder’s authority to view company limits and the active payment-limit setting before sharing any information.
Mandate check confirms Maeve Calder may view company limits. The active setting is a maximum of £20,000 per outgoing payment.
Your current company-profile limit is £20,000 per outgoing payment. No limit change or payment has been made; this confirmation does not authorise a payment above the limit.
